about: Read by flavour_gate.py. The KMD markers are literals of driver/kmd/entry.c, display.c and lab_gate.c; test_flavour_gate.py checks that each one is still in the source. A forbidden name is one whose lookup the release flavour compiles out; its lab field names the files whose lab build must still hold it (every), or says why no lab file does (none). An item of every is a file name (every copy) or a payload path (that copy only); with paths the list is exact and note says why the other copies lack the name. An allowed name stays, for the reason given. An out-of-scope name is recorded where it is found and never fails.

flavour_markers.release: kmd: BD-167 flavour release (no raw diagnostic escapes)
flavour_markers.lab: kmd: BD-167 flavour lab (raw diagnostic escapes, test signing + LabDiagnostics)

lab_escape_markers.escapes: the lab gate itself (test signing + LabDiagnostics)

allowed.name: AMDGPU_WDDM_LOG
allowed.where: every shell and engine of this driver
allowed.reason: our own support log: it chooses where diagnostics are written, it reads nothing

allowed.name: DXVK_HUD
allowed.reason: the user-visible overlay; it draws statistics and loads no code

allowed.name: DXVK_CONFIG
allowed.reason: an inline option string parsed against the option table; no option names a file of code. driver/umd/dxvk/ddi-adapter.cpp sets it in-process (sampler anisotropy, HUD)

allowed.name: VKD3D_CONFIG
allowed.reason: flags parsed against vkd3d_config_options with vkd3d_parse_debug_options; no flag names a file

allowed.name: DXIL_SPIRV_CONFIG

allowed.name: VKD3D_SAMPLER_ANISOTROPY

allowed.name: MESA_GLSL_CACHE_DISABLE

allowed.name: LP_NUM_THREADS
allowed.reason: the llvmpipe thread count of the CPU UMD

out_of_scope.name: VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS

out_of_scope.reason: system loader behaviour for every Vulkan application, not this driver's lookup; out of BD-167 scope. Its hits are recorded, never failed
